description: This file contains shell script functions implementing DHCP protocol configuration, setup, renewal, and teardown for network interfaces, including building dhcp options and invoking udhcpc.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCP protocol configuration options with default and user-specified parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Appends DHCP send options if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCP client with specified configuration, builds options, and launches udhcpc.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Forces DHCP lease renewal by sending SIGUSR1 to udhcpc process.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Terminates DHCP client process for the interface.
